question: Does the source-trained soft-token classification head distinguish real physical objects when only the requested noun changes? Can that information resolve the competition between two referents that the legal score range of slim v1 usually allows?
population: Use the complete previously sealed 32-frame, 64 direction-pair, 128 single-utterance noun-substitution panel for the new experiment. Both utterances run independently. The six-direction bound diagnosis uses all 18,620 ordinary records. A source checkpoint, seed, and physical frame define one capture. If there is no new two-subject success on the measured regions, stop this recipe at the panel. Any positive mechanistic result must be tested at full scale before adoption.
inputs: Frozen slim v1 and the exact raw LiDAR samples and seed coordinates in the previous study. Six registered physical nouns. For each noun use 'The {noun} . not mentioned' to match the native training suffix. Read the same first noun token position in every prompt and the last of 256 classification positions (unmatched in the training loss). No object IDs, class labels, other sentences, new training, updates, RGB appearance, or FINAL in prediction.
exposure: Share the actual point backbone across the six utterances. Force the same four disjoint interleaved slates of 256 seed IDs through the final native decoder, covering all 1,024 seeds in every noun condition. Check this reproduction on unmodified native-selected queries against full inference per available checkpoint. Pool duplicate seed positions once and use each distinct nearest seed to a physical object's support only once. All arms use exactly the same observations.
field: At seed i and condition c read L_ic = native_first_subject_token_logit - native_no_object_logit. Double center across unique seeds and the six noun conditions. Equal-weight mean of the resulting log evidence over seeds owning this object's observed returns. Multiply the previous tree class distribution by exp(evidence) and normalize over the six classes. It is a parameter-free working likelihood tilt, not a calibrated generative likelihood. The neutral row intercept cancels algebraically.
control_details: token_direct uses raw odds, contrastive_interaction uses the native normalized query dot the first noun embedding divided by 0.07 under identical forward passes, no_object_interaction uses only minus unmatched logit, and wrong_support assigns the entire evidence vector to a different physical seed by a half-rotation in lexicographically sorted unique XYZ. Independent and wrong_reference use the main field with independent subject choice or same-scene incorrect reference geometry. Keep the original measured-node tree, registration, unary priors, geometric completion, constraints, readout, and fallback for all arms.
diagnostic_after_seal: Supply the complete annotated geometry (no categories in inference) separately to isolate region coverage. Classify selected subject/reference errors as wrong class, a different object of the correct class, or abstention. Derive true-counterfactual ranks, two-name assignment and each single/pair identity, threshold counts, all harms and all failures. For geometry in actual prediction, score measured vs previous same-node completion and record beyond-pool repairs with both ownership definitions. Do not count shared frames from two source directions as independent replicates. This panel enumerates dataset-constructed expressions, not spontaneous natural captions.
